in_game_description: Electronics today are comprised of mainly of quantum and nano components. Even a cocktail glass has nano-electronic sensors built into it, which change the glass's color when it's empty so the bartender knows it needs refilling.
mechanics_text: 3t of Electronics are required for the Amour Rocket blueprint.
5t of Electronics are required for the Phoenix SIS blueprint.
10t of Electronics are required for the AMR Extinctor blueprint.
10t of Electronics are required for the Liberator blueprint.
30t of Electronics are required for the Disruptor Laser blueprint.
40t of Electronics are required for the Khador Drive blueprint.
45t of Electronics are required for the Rhoda Blackhole blueprint.
75t of Electronics are required for the Fluxed Matter Shield blueprint.
75t of Electronics are required for the Particle Shield blueprint.
In Galaxy on Fire 3D, electronics look more futuristic than in Galaxy on Fire 2.
